column3: Kill 9 Theramore Infiltrators, then return to Nazeer Bloodpike in Brackenwall Village.
column4: The Horde and Alliance hold an uneasy truce.  Outlying skirmishes and covert actions are taken by one side against the other, and it is our duty to ensure the Horde is on top!$B$BNow is the chance to do just that.$B$BAlliance infiltrators have taken positions east of Brackenwall Village.  They spy on the village and report our movements to Theramore, which we cannot allow.$B$BHunt down the infiltrators and slay them.  Send a clear message to their superiors that we will not tolerate their spies' presence!

column3: Free $1oa Webbed Victims in Night's Web Hollow for Aramis Hammerhand in Deathknell.
column4:
Greetings, $c. Yes, I am a paladin. Not even death can stop the Light.

This is something my kind have in common with all Forsaken--we have overcome what the living view as their end. However, some even among our own fear us; they suspect we will smite them as some monstrosity.

In truth, our relationship with undeath is complex, but I am not here to hurt our own. Help me show the others this. Venture to Night's Web Hollow to the northwest and free the freshly raised fools trapped by the spiders there.

column3: Find Heglan Shadeeye north of Tiragarde Keep.
column4: A member of the Shattered Hand, a group of more... subtle fighters, was watching Tiragarde Keep from a distance. Her reports suddenly stopped coming in.\r\n\r\nI doubt the humans would have caught her, so I'm concerned something more dangerous is at play. See if you can find her. Hopefully the messages are just delayed.

column3: Bring the Bundle of Hides to the hermit on the ridge overlooking the Dry Hills in the Barrens.
column4: These hides are bound for a tanner who I often trade with. He is something of a hermit and he lives alone on the top of the ridge behind me. Climbing up a steep hillside isn't something I can manage easily right now so I'd be in your debt if you could make this delivery for me.\r\n\r\nOh, and about this tanner's... appearance. You need not be alarmed. In spite of his looks, he is no threat. I swear this is true.

column3: Free Gol'dir then return to Krusk in Tarren Mill.
column4: From what I can tell of the documents you procured, Gol'dir is being held in a large Syndicate base to the north, most likely in the Alterac Mountains. He has been held captive far too long and must be freed.Find where Gol'dir is being held

column3: Cook Torka in Razor Hill wants you to collect 8 Prickly Pear Fruit from the Razormane Grounds west of town.
column4: Our hunters and fishers bring back plenty of savory food for our troops - but it's rare that they get a sweet treat.\r\n\r\nI've seen a cactus that produces a prickly, tasty fruit. But it only grows in the hills to the west, where the wretched quilboars make their camps. Make your way past the quilboars and bring me some of those fruits. And be careful - the fruits are as spiny as the quilboars!

In addition to spreading their filth across the Charred Vale, the Bloodfury harpies gather anything shiny that they can find. I'm told that they collect a variety of golden-yellow sunstones for decoration. I have no use for such trinkets, but Mor'rogal has mentioned using them before.\r\n\r\nWhile you're fighting the harpies of the Vale, keep your eye out for Glittering Sunstones. Bring any that you find to Mor'rogal, up on the hills above us.

column3: Bring 25 Bloody Bone Necklaces to Kin'weelay at the Grom'gol Base Camp.
column4: I was sent to Grom'gol  to aid Nimboya on his quest, but... I too have reasons for being here.$B$BThe Bloodscalp tribe is enemy to our tribe.  Collecting trophies of our enemies gives us power over them.  You may aid our tribe by hunting our enemies.$B$BThey dwell to the north.  Slay Bloodscalp trolls and take from them their bloody bone necklaces.  Collect many, and your reward will be great.

column3: Bring the Defiant Orc Head to Nazeer Bloodpike in Brackenwall Village.
column4: Vigorous digging reveals the head of a male orc, raggedly severed at the neck.  His lips are frozen in a snarl, and its dark eyes stare defiantly.

column3: Retrieve Helcular's Rod from the Yeti and bring it back to Novice Thaivand in Tarren Mill.
column4: Master Helcular was almost complete with his transformation into a Lich when a human lynch mob discovered his ritual lair in the hills and brutally killed him.  To make matters worse they buried his corpse in the Southshore cemetery.$b$bSuch disregard for the great wizard is unacceptable.  As his apprentice I shall see to it that the rains of vengeance fall upon the town of Southshore.$b$bWe will need Helcular's Rod first.  Yeti overtook his ritual lair.  Undoubtedly one of the beasts has it.
